howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: You create your trainer profile and verify your identity.
howItWorks.step2: Clients find you nearby or with your code, and send you a request.
howItWorks.step3: You assign workouts, plan sessions and chat with them.
howItWorks.step4: You see their sets, reps and weights, and their measurements if they share them.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.note: Prices for Spain, VAT included. In other countries the app shows your local price. Your clients use Rekalp for free.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your Rekalp account
deleteAccount.withoutAppBody: Email us from your account's email address with the subject "Delete account". Timeframe: up to 30 days.
deleteAccount.mailtoButton: Email us to delete my account
deleteAccount.mailtoBody: Hi, I want to delete my Rekalp account associated with this email address.%0D%0A%0D%0AThanks.
deleteAccount.dataDeleted: Deleted: your name, your email, your client and trainer profiles, your photos, the documents you uploaded and the health limitations you shared. All your sessions are closed, your notes and rating comments are cleared, and your relationships with trainers or clients end (the other person is told).
deleteAccount.dataKept: Kept anonymously, no longer linked to you: your workouts, custom exercises, records and measurements, and the stars of the ratings you gave. Your conversations are closed and removed a few days later.
deleteAccount.subscriptionWarningBody: Deleting your account doesn't cancel your subscriptions (Rekalp Pro or trainer seats). Cancel them first in your App Store or Google Play account settings: deleting the account doesn't stop billing.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Rekalp ("the App") is run by BRT Digital Media ("we", "us"). This policy explains what data we collect, why we use it, who can see it and what choices you have.
privacy.summaryBody: We use your data to run Rekalp and keep it safe. Your health data is never used for ads and is only shared with a trainer if you agree. Trainer identity checks need the trainer's explicit consent.
privacy.s1Title: 1. Who is responsible for your data
privacy.s1Body: BRT Digital Media is the controller of your personal data. You can reach us at rekalpfitness+legal@gmail.com or with the button at the end of this page.
privacy.s2Intro: Depending on how you use Rekalp, we collect:
privacy.s2Account: Account: your email, name, date of birth, gender, language, units and app preferences.
privacy.s2Training: Training and body data: your workouts, exercises, personal records, body measurements (such as weight or body fat), the BMI we calculate from them and the reminders you set.
privacy.s2Photos: Photos: your profile picture stays on your device. If you use Personal Trainer, the photo you choose for your trainer or client profile is stored on our servers so others can see it.
privacy.s2Client: Personal Trainer, as a client: your client profile (photo, short bio, goals, training preferences, level, availability, city and approximate area), your requests, plans and sessions, the workouts your trainer assigns with their results and, only if you choose to share them, your health limitations.
privacy.s2Trainer: Personal Trainer, as a trainer: your public profile (name, photo, bio, specialties, plans and prices, city and approximate area), the qualification documents you upload, your ratings and your seats subscription.
privacy.s2Identity: Identity check (trainers only, optional): a trainer can verify their identity with a specialised provider, which checks the identity document and that the person matches it. We only receive the result, the document type, the name on the document and whether the minimum age is met. We don't keep images of your document or your face.
privacy.s2Messages: Messages and safety: chat messages between trainers and clients, blocks and the reports people send us.
privacy.s2Ratings: Ratings: the stars and the optional comment a client gives a trainer.
privacy.s2Device: Device and security: device type, app version, session details, notification identifiers and technical logs (including IP addresses), to keep your account secure and synced.
privacy.s2Purchases: Purchases: the status of your subscriptions, which Apple or Google confirm to us. We never see your card details.
privacy.s2Analytics: Usage statistics: how the app's features are used, linked to a random identifier, not to your name or email.
privacy.s2Ads: Ads (free plan only): our advertising partner may use your device's advertising identifier, with your consent where the law requires it.
privacy.s2Web: Website: basic technical data about your visit.
privacy.s2Support: Support: the messages you send us.
privacy.s3Title: 3. Why we use it and on what legal basis
privacy.s3Contract: To give you the app and the features you ask for: your account, syncing, Personal Trainer and subscriptions (basis: our contract with you).
privacy.s3Health: To store and show your body measurements when you choose to log them (basis: our contract with you), and to share them or your health limitations with your trainer only if you agree (basis: your explicit consent; see section 9).
privacy.s3Identity: To verify the identity of a trainer who chooses to do so (basis: the trainer's explicit consent, asked before the check).
privacy.s3Safety: To keep Rekalp safe: protect accounts, prevent fraud and abuse, check messages and public texts for offensive content and act on reports (basis: our legitimate interest, and yours, in a safe service).
privacy.s3Improve: To understand how the app is used and improve it (basis: our legitimate interest).
privacy.s3Ads: To show ads in the free plan, and personalised ads only with your consent where required.
privacy.s3Notify: To send the notifications you've allowed, such as messages, session alerts or reminders (basis: your permission, which you control in your device settings).
privacy.s3Legal: To meet legal duties, such as keeping purchase records or answering authorities (basis: legal obligation).
privacy.s4Users: Other Rekalp users: everyone can see a trainer's public profile. A trainer you send a request to sees your name, photo, age, approximate distance, goals, the plan you choose and your message, never your email, date of birth or exact location. If you share your health limitations, they see them too. While you train together, they see the results of the workouts they assign you and, if you agree to share them, your body measurements. Your stars count toward the trainer's public average; only the trainer sees the comment, with your name.
privacy.s4Providers: Service providers working for us: hosting and databases, messaging and notifications, image storage, email delivery, identity verification, usage statistics and support tools. Each one only receives the data it needs for its job, never more. For example, image storage only keeps the photos and documents you upload, without your email or other account details, and email delivery only receives your address and the sign-in code.
privacy.s4Stores: Apple and Google, to handle subscriptions and deliver notifications.
privacy.s4AdPartner: Our advertising partner (Google), in the free plan, under its own privacy policy.
privacy.s4Authorities: Authorities, courts or advisers, only when the law requires it or to defend our rights.
privacy.s5Body: To protect the community, messages and public texts are checked automatically for offensive content, and identity checks are largely automated. If an automated check stops you from doing something, you can ask us to have a person review it.
privacy.s6Body: Some of our providers process data outside the European Economic Area. When they do, we use the safeguards the law requires, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or adequacy decisions.
privacy.s7Active: While your account is active, we keep your data so the app works.
privacy.s7Chat: Chat messages are deleted after 90 days. A whole conversation is removed 7 days after the training relationship ends. If there's an open report, the conversation is kept until we've dealt with it.
privacy.s7Identity: Identity check: the result is kept while you have a trainer account. When you delete your account, we ask the provider to delete what it holds about you.
privacy.s7Deleted: When you delete your account: your name and email, your client and trainer profiles, photos and the health limitations you shared are deleted; your notes and rating comments are cleared, and your sessions are closed. Your workouts, records and measurements are kept only in anonymous form, no longer linked to you. Ratings you gave keep their stars, anonymously.
privacy.s7Reports: Reports and records needed for safety or legal claims are kept as long as needed for that purpose.
privacy.s7Documents: The qualification documents a trainer uploads are only seen by our review team and are deleted once we've reviewed them. We only keep the result and what we need to detect duplicate documents.
privacy.s7Purchases: Purchase records are kept as long as tax and consumer law require.
privacy.s8Body: You can access, correct, delete or download your data, object to or restrict how we use it, and withdraw any consent at any time. Withdrawing consent doesn't affect what we did before. You can also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
privacy.s8Where: Many of these options are in the app: edit your profile, change what you share with your trainer and delete your account. For anything else, write to us and we'll reply within one month.
privacy.s9Body: Body measurements, BMI and health limitations are health data, a category the law protects more strongly. We only use them for the features you asked for and never for ads. Your trainer only sees your measurements if you agree to share them, and only while you train together; you can stop sharing them at any time from your Personal Trainer profile. Your health limitations are only shared with your explicit consent and are deleted if you withdraw it.
privacy.s10Body: Rekalp is not meant for people under 16, and we don't knowingly collect their data. You must be at least 18 to offer services as a trainer.
privacy.s11Body: We encrypt data in transit, limit who can access it and review our security measures. No system is perfectly secure, so please keep your device and email account safe too.
privacy.s12Body: The free plan shows ads. Where the law requires it, we ask for your consent with each platform's standard tools (Google's consent form in Europe and Apple's tracking prompt on iPhone). Rekalp Pro has no ads.
privacy.s13Body: This website only uses strictly necessary cookies, so it doesn't need a cookie banner.
privacy.s14Body: We may update this policy. If a change is important, we'll tell you in the app before it applies.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy? Write to us.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Rekalp ("the App"), run by BRT Digital Media ("we", "us"). By creating an account or using the App, you accept them. Please also read our Privacy Policy.
terms.s1Body: Rekalp helps you plan, log and follow your training: exercise catalogue, workout history, personal records, body measurements and statistics. With Personal Trainer, clients find trainers and trainers work with their clients: requests, plans, sessions, assigned workouts, progress and chat.
terms.s2Item1: You must be at least 16 (18 to offer services as a trainer).
terms.s2Item2: Give accurate information and keep it up to date.
terms.s2Item3: You sign in with your email and a one-time code. Keep your email account and device secure: you're responsible for what happens in your account.
terms.s2Item4: One account per person. Your plan limits how many devices can be signed in at the same time.
terms.s3Body: Rekalp is free. There are two optional subscriptions: Rekalp Pro (no ads and more devices) and trainer seats (how many clients a trainer can train at the same time). They're charged through the App Store or Google Play.
terms.s3Item1: They renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
terms.s3Item2: Manage or cancel them in your Apple or Google account settings, not in the App.
terms.s3Item3: Deleting the App or your account doesn't cancel a subscription.
terms.s3Item4: Prices are shown before you buy and may vary by country and currency. Refunds follow Apple's or Google's rules.
terms.s3Item5: A subscription belongs to the Rekalp account that bought it and can't be moved to another account while it's active.
terms.s4Body: Rekalp is a platform that helps trainers and clients find each other and work together. The training agreement is between the trainer and the client: we're not part of it, we don't employ trainers and we don't guarantee their services. Payments for training are arranged directly between trainer and client, outside the App.
terms.s5Item1: You must be at least 18 and keep your profile truthful. The identity check is optional: it makes your profile more reliable and professional, and lets clients find you when they filter for verified trainers.
terms.s5Item2: Only claim qualifications you really have. We may review the documents you upload and remove badges or profiles that aren't backed up.
terms.s5Item3: You're responsible for your services, your advice and for meeting the legal, tax, insurance and professional requirements where you work.
terms.s5Item4: Use your clients' data only to train them, keep it confidential and don't take it out of the App for other purposes.
terms.s5Item5: How many clients you can train at the same time depends on your seats. If your seats go down, some relationships may end, as explained in the App.
terms.s5Item6: The average and number of your ratings can be shown on your public profile. You can't edit or remove them.
terms.s6Item1: Your trainer's advice comes from the trainer, not from Rekalp.
terms.s6Item2: Tell your trainer about any health issue that matters for your training. Sharing health limitations in the App is optional.
terms.s6Item3: Rate honestly, based on your own experience.
terms.s7Body: Rekalp has zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive behaviour. You must not:
terms.s7Item1: harass, threaten, insult or discriminate against anyone;
terms.s7Item2: post sexual, violent, hateful or illegal content;
terms.s7Item3: send spam, scams or advertising unrelated to training;
terms.s7Item4: share other people's personal data or images without their permission;
terms.s7Item5: impersonate someone or lie about your identity or qualifications.
terms.s7Enforce: Messages and public texts are checked automatically, and you can block and report anyone from a conversation. We review reports within 24 hours and may remove content, end relationships and suspend or close accounts that break these rules.
terms.s8Body: What you create in the App (workouts, notes, custom exercises, profiles and messages) stays yours. You give us a free, worldwide licence to store, process and show it as needed to run and improve the App, and to show your public profile and ratings to other users. The licence ends when your content is deleted, except for anonymous data and what we must keep by law.
terms.s9Body: Don't misuse the App: don't try to access our systems or other people's accounts without authorisation, don't interfere with other users or with how the service works, don't scrape data automatically and don't use it for illegal purposes. We reserve the right to take legal action against any unauthorised access to our systems.
terms.healthWarningBody: Rekalp doesn't give medical advice. Talk to a professional before starting an exercise programme, especially if you have a health condition. BMI, estimated 1RM and other figures are guidance, not a diagnosis. Train within your limits.
terms.s10Body: We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms or put others at risk. You can delete your account at any time from the App (Profile → Settings → Delete account) or from our website.
terms.s11Body: We provide the App "as is" and can't promise it will always work without interruptions or errors. To the extent the law allows, we aren't liable for indirect damages, for injuries from exercise or for the services, advice or conduct of trainers and other users. Nothing in these terms limits consumer rights that can't be waived.
terms.s12Body: We may update these terms. We'll tell you in the App before an important change applies. If you keep using the App afterwards, you accept the new terms; if you don't agree, you can delete your account.
terms.s13Body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. If you're a consumer, you're also protected by the mandatory rules and courts of the country where you live.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms? Write to us.
